implementation.authoritative_surface: periodic axis spline plus bicubic radial spline
implementation.patches: one conservative patch per physical spline span
implementation.proxy: two corner triangles plus curvature/twist error tube
implementation.acceleration: contiguous patches and flattened front-to-back BVH2
implementation.local_solver: projected 2x2 damped Newton with patch-local power-polynomial evaluation
implementation.ambiguous_case: patch-local ray subdivision and derivative-stationary tangent resolution
implementation.global_interval_precursor: retained private negative/offline precursor; not called by distance()

target_metrics.comment: The initial internal candidate/iteration targets were missed, but the end-to-end minimum speed gate passed. Further BVH/seed optimization remains useful.
